status_detail: Independent synchronous build: 3 formal pairs on one real sample, 8/8 waveforms bit-identical; root cause of the asynchronous waveform difference not fully proven
hypothesis: PreDiT (OpenCL FP16) outputs are consumed by the FP32 DiT before the GPU writes are visible; an explicit wait on the PreDiT outputs removes the waveform difference between tile0 and tile4 builds
change: Wait on every PreDiT output tensor (MAP_TENSOR_READ) when OMNI_PREDIT_SYNC is present in the environment, before passing them to the FP32 DiT

integration.apply: git apply experiments/predit-sync/predit-sync.patch (against the repository's src/mnn/omni.cpp overlay)
integration.enable: OMNI_PREDIT_SYNC present (any value); disable by unsetting

limitations: One sample, three formal pairs, one board
Removing the observed difference is not a proof of root cause
Adds a host synchronization point at the PreDiT -> DiT hand-off
